units.title: whole-envelope PUT checkpoint on a journal-native campaign
units.behavior: an accepted whole-envelope PUT on a journal-native campaign appends a CampaignSnapshotPublished checkpoint of the stored record in the same transaction as the row write, so the journal head is never behind the record; the create path gets the same shape (row and genesis in one transaction, so a genesis refusal cannot leave a committed row behind a 500).
units.designQuestionFirst: the writer contract forbids nesting saveCampaign in its prepared extension (SQLiteEventJournalWriter.ts:93). Options: (i) invert: the journal writer owns the one immediate transaction (appendPreparedWithExtension) and the campaigns row write is its extension; (ii) refuse whole-envelope PUTs on journal-native campaigns with a typed 409, which breaks every unrewired single-player save once the flip lands; (iii) append after saveCampaign in the route, which is not one transaction and leaves a crash window. Recommendation: (i).

proposedSplit.openQuestionForTheParent: The behaviour sentence says every create OR ADOPT appends a genesis snapshot and a journal-native marker. After the flip, adopt imports a baseline under the migration principal and writes a SHADOWING marker (campaignLegacyAdoption.ts:144-155; campaignAuthorityMigration.ts:227), and shadowing resolves to snapshot authority (campaignAuthorityMode.ts:91-95) with nothing that advances it. Under OD-mvp-hard-cutover shadow parity is not required, but changing adoption is an authority-path edit that also touches the migration-authored snapshot U58 is about. It needs a ruling or a unit of its own; no proposed unit above holds it.

risksForTheParent: Review classes authority + idempotency + migration: every successor that changes what create, adopt, a command acknowledgement or a PUT commits needs the owner head-bound Lane B ruling on the head it merges; OD-mvp-hard-cutover delegates the design answers, not the ruling.
U28 depends on this landing (the E2E-01/02 genesis clauses need the flip, not the fixture arm); the split puts four units in front of U28 instead of one.

The main proof of the flip must run verify:qc:coop-campaign-journey and the authority-recovery ladder group: with the flip every new co-op campaign is journal-native and every co-op creation requires the marker (campaignCreationCheckpoint.ts:214-221).

Measured: after the flip a create whose envelope the genesis projection refuses (double-claimed or absent force units) answers 500 AFTER saveCampaign committed the row ([id].ts:197 vs :248-264), and a client retry at baseVersion 0 then meets the 409 stale-write guard. The shared test fixture double-claims unit ids (src/lib/campaign/persistence/__tests__/campaignFixture.ts:31); whether real client envelopes can do so is UNVERIFIED.

After the flip, campaigns created before it (no marker) cannot host co-op (the checkpoint refuses), and adopted campaigns sit in shadowing on snapshot authority; under OD-mvp-hard-cutover no pre-cutover data is protected, but a local dev database would show it.

Gate (3) goes live the moment the flip lands: the client is not rewired (task 1.2), so every single-player save of a new campaign is a whole-envelope PUT the journal does not see (measured). The flip must not land before U35b.

findingsReportedNotFixed.finding: F-1 reproduced on the baseline: the marker write throws after the batch committed, executeCampaignCommand rejects, and the commands route answers 500 for a committed command. It needs a catch (and a log) around the post-commit marker report, or the marker write moved into the journal transaction. Outside the path; the unit cannot meet gate (1) without it.
Gate (3) holds (measured). The fix is a transaction-shape change in the service or the route, outside the path; the unit cannot meet gate (3) without it.

Create is not atomic with genesis: the row commits before the genesis append, and a genesis refusal answers 500 with the row already at version 1 (measured under the flip through campaigns.test.ts:143). Outside the path.
Adopt writes a shadowing marker, not a journal-native one, while the behaviour sentence says create or adopt. Outside the path; needs a ruling.
The charter places saveCampaign under src/lib/campaign/persistence; grep finds it only at src/services/campaignPersistence/CampaignPersistenceService.ts:107.
Both import CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_E2E_ENV from the in-path resolver module; deleting the constant with the arm breaks their type-check. The flip unit must keep the constant or own those files.
